identity_model.auth_key: Identity Platform UID bound server-side to user_id
identity_model.project_id: 32 lowercase hex immutable public identifier; not a capability

provider_guards.firestore_server_only: Cloud Run service account is the data plane. Browser Firebase/Firestore rules must deny direct product-data access; Breadmaker HTTP authorization remains authoritative.
provider_guards.gcs_names: Server constructs every object key from validated opaque IDs/hashes. user filenames, emails, titles, URLs and paths never become authority-bearing object path segments.
provider_guards.gcs_create_precondition: Immutable/create paths use ifGenerationMatch=0. Replace/delete operations require the previously observed object generation when applicable.

generation_model.project_generation: projects/{project_id}.generation is the global logical commit generation and successor to local projects.project_generation semantics.
generation_model.entity_generation: Mutable aggregate roots carry their own generation/revision for focused optimistic concurrency.
generation_model.bulk_mutation_protocol: Operations exceeding one Firestore transaction (large import/restore/restructure) create a durable operation record, lock project mutation to that operation, apply idempotent bounded batches, verify target state, then atomically publish/finalize the new project generation. Reads must not present partially applied state as committed. A crashed operation must be resumable or safely rolled back from its immutable pre-operation revision.

publication_order: write immutable GCS revision object with ifGenerationMatch=0
Firestore transaction validates expected current generation and publishes current-state/revision pointer

orphan_policy.allowed_failure: Orphan GCS immutable object may exist without a Firestore authoritative reference when publication transaction fails.
orphan_policy.forbidden_failure: Firestore current/revision pointer must never reference a missing or hash-mismatched GCS object.
orphan_policy.cleanup: Orphan discovery is asynchronous/idempotent and retention-delayed; object creation is never rolled back by destructive guesswork inside the failed request.

delete_policy.project: Tombstone first, deny normal access, preserve owner recovery authority, delay physical GC.
delete_policy.children: Current-state delete is allowed only inside a generation commit and remains recoverable from immutable revision/checkpoint history until retention expires.

authorization.project_member: Resolve authenticated Breadmaker user_id, then read projects/{project_id}/members/{user_id}. Missing project and missing membership share the public not-found class. Project IDs are never capabilities.
authorization.project_owner: Require projects/{project_id}/members/{user_id}.role == owner after normal membership authorization.
authorization.project_member_or_review_participant: Writer/member access uses project membership. Reviewer access must prove a server-issued participant session bound to review_id + participant_id + snapshot_id; a participant ID alone is never authority.
authorization.user_self: Authenticated identity must map server-side to the same internal Breadmaker user_id. Email is never an authorization key.
authorization.system_only: Not directly addressable by an end user; server operation must already hold the containing project/user authorization.

concurrency.project_generation_cas: Firestore transaction checks the expected project generation, applies bounded metadata/current-state writes, and advances projects/{project_id}.generation exactly once. Stale expected generation returns conflict and does not overwrite.
concurrency.entity_generation_cas: Mutable entity stores an entity generation. Update transaction checks expected entity generation and advances both entity generation and project generation.
concurrency.chapter_generation_cas: Chapter save checks chapter generation/revision; all block mutations for that logical save are idempotent. If the save exceeds one atomic Firestore transaction, use the durable bulk-mutation protocol and expose no partial state as committed.
concurrency.immutable_create_only: Immutable object/document creation is create-only. GCS writes use ifGenerationMatch=0; duplicate retry is accepted only when content hash/identity match exactly.
concurrency.append_only: Create-only opaque ID; updates are forbidden. Duplicate retries require identical immutable payload identity.
concurrency.single_document_cas: One Firestore document transaction checks its generation and advances it plus project generation.
concurrency.derived: No authoritative mutation. Recompute from authoritative state or regenerate derived artifact.

delete.project_tombstone: Transaction sets status=deleted, deleted_at, deleted_by and removes normal access while retaining owner recovery authority. Physical Firestore/GCS garbage collection is delayed and idempotent.
delete.current_hard_delete_revision_recoverable: Remove from current Firestore state in an authorized generation commit; immutable revision/checkpoint history remains the recovery source until retention GC.
delete.tombstone_then_gc: Set deleted_at/tombstone first so normal reads stop immediately; physical child/object cleanup is asynchronous and idempotent.
delete.immutable_retention_gc: Never mutate in place. Delete only when no authoritative reference remains and retention policy permits GC.
delete.derived_delete: Derived/temporary data may be deleted immediately and regenerated; it is never the sole copy of user data.
delete.user_soft_delete: Disable/tombstone the user record first; personal object deletion follows privacy-erasure workflow.

recovery.project_revision: Recovered from immutable hosted project revision/checkpoint history plus object hashes; current Firestore state is reconstructible.
recovery.snapshot_object: Authoritative immutable GCS object plus hash/generation metadata is the recovery representation.
recovery.project_revision_or_snapshot: Current metadata is recoverable from project revision history; immutable payload/snapshot object is independently integrity checked.
recovery.user_profile: User metadata is included in account export/backup; avatar object is immutable/versioned and referenced by hash/generation.
recovery.derived: No independent backup requirement; regenerate from authoritative state.
recovery.security_config: Backed up as infrastructure/configuration state, not project manuscript data. Secret payloads are excluded from Firestore/GCS project backups.

non_sql_state_mappings.id_policy: Document id is SHA-256 of Identity Platform UID; document stores exact UID + internal user_id. Email is metadata only.
non_sql_state_mappings.notes: Separate Breadmaker user_id is locked in Milestone 2; this permits provider migration/linking without making email or provider UID the product authorization key.
User document stores current avatar hash/object generation/revision. Old versions are retention-GC candidates.

non_sql_state_mappings.authorization_policy: project_owner for mutation; project_member for self read
non_sql_state_mappings.notes: Exactly one owner role is required. member_id remains an opaque audit identity; user_id is the document key.
Hosted has no machine-global active project registry. Per-user last-opened state lives on membership/user metadata. Portable manifests are generated views, not authority.
Asset object name is server-generated from validated bytes/hash. Firestore metadata preserves logical API asset identity and reference lifecycle; no user path becomes a GCS key.

Hosted revision format is a new cloud format, not a byte-for-byte copy of local revision store v1. It preserves generation lineage, state hash, author identity, parent revision, object hash/generation and manifest-last publication semantics.
Scheduling/retention state is reconstructible from published immutable backup/revision manifests. It is not manuscript authority.

Non-secret destination metadata may be Firestore. OAuth refresh tokens/passwords/API secrets must live outside Firestore/GCS project data (Secret Manager or provider-managed credential storage). Third-party backup authorization remains independent of Breadmaker login.
Temporary/derived with lifecycle TTL. Never the only copy of manuscript state.
Short TTL. Validation happens before canonical publication. Import creates a fresh hosted project ID (new hosted project_id) and cannot overwrite an existing project by package ID.
No directory move in hosted storage. Trash is authoritative project tombstone + retention deadline; normal membership reads fail closed while owner recovery endpoint can restore.
Never project authority. OAuth codes/tokens/secrets/manuscript bodies must remain excluded by logging policy.

non_sql_state_mappings.source: session undo journal / process-local UI editing state
non_sql_state_mappings.notes: Cloud Run restart may discard this state only if committed project state remains correct. Durable undo/history is revision-backed, not instance-memory-backed.
